measurementBasis: Easee wall-energy delta from immutable session baseline divided by user-confirmed Tesla SOC delta
notes: Tesla SOC is not available automatically in Homey.
Start SOC comes from the user's deadline command; end SOC must be confirmed by the user from the Tesla app.
The operational 0.59 kWh/% factor remains frozen until five valid calibration sessions have been collected and reviewed.
Charging losses are therefore not added separately during the collection period; the empirical wall-kWh/% factor already includes them implicitly.

sessions.equalizerLimitation: NOT_PROVEN; no limitation visible at end snapshot, but offered/current context was not fully clean during the session
sessions.notes: Immutable lifetime-meter baseline/end pair used for the completed session. A later Homey snapshot showed the charger paused at 7781.01 kWh; that later movement is outside this captured calibration endpoint and is not added to this session.

observations.reason: Useful indication only: Easee lastCharge is not proven to share the exact immutable deadline baseline, so this point is not counted among the five valid calibration sessions.
